answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 150505 Country: INDIA Title: I have kept my son's name as Asad Ahmed, is it ok or need to keep Asadullah? Question: I have kept my son's name as Asad Ahmed, is it ok or need to keep Asadullah? Answer ID: 150505 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 733/558/D=8/1438) It is also good to name someone Asad Ahmed. However, Asadullah is far better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
